description: Use this to change something, after get_asset: one the user saved (asset_id) or a set or design you made in this conversation (handle). Rewrite or restyle text, move, resize or recolour layers, add art you draw as SVG, a library piece (search_library), a phone frame or new text, remove or reorder layers, move or resize the phone or change its model, colour and fold, change the background or the loop, turn the whole set landscape or portrait or give it another size of the same asset (set_canvas), rename, duplicate, reorder or remove screens. Send only what changes, with the revision get_asset returned; the asset changes at once (like an edit in the editor) and the reply has the new revision, previews of the changed screens and warnings. A set or design changed this way keeps changing here: update_project and update_design no longer apply to it. With asset_id (something the user saved) it needs the user signed in to appdesigns (in Claude Code type /mcp, pick appdesigns and choose Authenticate (or run `claude mcp login appdesigns` in a separate terminal), in Codex run `codex mcp login appdesigns`; other agents open the sign-in page themselves); with handle (a set or design you made in this conversation, not saved yet) it needs no sign-in.

changes.description: Applied in order, all or none. Layer positions count from 0 at the bottom of the screen's layers list, the phone included.

gradient.description: A gradient instead of a plain colour; radial runs from the centre out.

angle.description: linear: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom. Default 90.

colors.description: 2 to 5 colours, evenly spread across the whole canvas.

canvas.description: set_canvas: the new canvas. Text keeps its place and size, as in the editor, so check the previews and move what needs it.

orientation.description: Turns the set, and the phone with it (the editor's orientation toggle). A size alone keeps the phone's stance, as the size chip does.

size.description: WIDTHxHEIGHT of the same asset: another iPhone display or the twin turned the other way, the Duo's other display, another marketing size (320 to 4096 a side).

id.description: The layer, for set_layer, remove_layer and move_layer.

layer.description: set_layer: only the fields to change; fields get_asset shows that only describe a layer (id, kind, box, what, frame, model_name, screenshot, locked) are ignored. Text: text, x, y, size, font, weight, color, align, line_height, wrap_width, rotation, motion (float, drift or sway). Picture: x, y, width or height, rotation, opacity, flip, tint (library pieces), svg or library (new art), motion. Phone frame layer: phone (a device id), color, fold, orientation, x, y, width or height, rotation, opacity, flip, motion. The screen's phone ("device"): shown, model, color, fold (inner-open/Unfolded, outer-closed/Cover, outer-open/Open back), x, y, height or width, rotation (-15 to 15), motion (listing assets). motion {"move":"none"} stops a move. add_layer: a whole new text (id, text, x, y, size), svg (id, svg, x, y, width), library (id, library, x, y, width) or phone frame (id, phone, x, y, height or width, and color, fold, orientation; screenshot "screen" shows the screen's own screenshot, else fill it with replace_screenshots) layer, with create_design's fields.

loop.description: set_loop, listing assets only: on, seconds, fps, background (still, flow, shift or zoom) and effects, as in create_design.

op.description: set_layer changes the fields you give of layer id ("device" is the phone); add_layer adds layer (on top, or at position to); remove_layer and move_layer (to a position in the screen's layer list, 0 is the bottom) take id; set_background, set_loop and set_title change the screen's; duplicate_screen copies the screen (to the screen number to, default right after it); remove_screen removes it; move_screen moves it to screen number to; set_canvas changes the canvas of every screen (canvas), as the editor's size chip and orientation toggle do.

screen.description: Which screen, from 1, as numbered after the changes before this one. Every op but set_canvas, which changes them all.

handle.description: Instead of asset_id: the project_handle create_project returned or the design_handle create_design returned, for something you made in this conversation that the user has not saved yet. Needs no sign-in.

revision.description: The revision get_asset (or the last edit_asset) returned. If the asset changed since, nothing changes and you read it again.

name: edit_asset
title: Change an asset
